turns: A hospital model gives two patient groups the same untreated recovery probability. Can we merge the groups when choosing a drug, although their drug responses differ?

failure: Uses untreated prediction to justify treatment equivalence.

turns: My optimizer has gradient norm 0.000001. Have I established that its answer is close to the global minimum?

expected: Compute each minimum as zero at x=n and identify escaping minimizers and noncommutation.
failure: Interchanges limit and minimization based on pointwise convergence.

turns: I have no problem to solve. I just want to play with the idea that a boundary can be an invitation.
